summary: The sky step is the weakest picture: photo-filter blur, pale chips where the trunks go and foliage ghosts carry through steps 1-3. Several steps (bark 6, leaves 8, wing 13) jump from a flat block-in to finished detail in colors the step never names, and the bird outline carries specks and a wing bump through many steps. Placement measurements all fall within tolerance; the text faults are contradictions between tips and pictures (red leaves, cheek gap).
